nota: Personaje (VIRALIDAD §7, 3 personajes por noticia: tras hot-inflation van oseola-mccarty y anne-scheiber, este es el 3.º). Tema atado a la demanda de hoy (decide: 'jensen huang' / 'huang resigns', 12-nov-2026; 'inflation report' ya cubierto por hot-inflation). Fuentes: Wikipedia Curtis_Priem (cofundó Nvidia en 1993 con Jensen Huang y Chris Malachowsky, CTO 1993-2003, se retiró en 2003, vendió todas sus acciones para 2006, regalo de $40M a Rensselaer en 2004); Forbes 26-nov-2023 (patrimonio ~$30M; con sus acciones, ~$70B); Wikipedia 3dfx (rival dominante que quebró y cuyos activos compró Nvidia en 2000); NBC News 12-nov-2026 (Nvidia cae tras la dimisión de Huang). Giro honesto: retrospectiva sesgada, el rival que parecía ganador quebró.

frases.texto: Curtis Priem, a co-founder of the biggest chip maker in your index fund, sold every single share.
That chip maker is Nvidia. Today its boss, Jensen Huang, quit, and the stock slid.
Priem was Nvidia's first chief technology officer.
He retired early and sold out.
Had he held, Forbes says, he'd be worth seventy billion dollars.
His actual fortune? About thirty million.
The worst sale in tech history, right?
Not to him. He gave forty million to his old college.
Hindsight cheats. Back then, Nvidia's rival looked unbeatable.
It went bust, and Nvidia bought what was left.
Nobody gets to sell only the losers.
So, would you have held every share?
Curtis Priem, a co-founder of the biggest chip maker in your index fund, is called the man who sold too soon.
That giant is Nvidia, and you'd probably call him that too.
Forbes figured his old shares would be worth seventy billion dollars.
He has about thirty million.
And today, as Jensen Huang steps down, that gap looks even crueler.
But the mistake is in how we judge him.
In the nineties, Nvidia's biggest rival looked like the sure winner.
It went bust. Nvidia bought the pieces.
Priem cashed out and gave forty million to his old college.
Holding only looks genius after the winner is known.
Too soon is a label we only hand out later, after the winner is called.

contradiccion.nota: Una idea (vender al ganador), el bucle 'worst sale?' se cierra tarde con el rival quebrado; la noticia de hoy da el porqué-ahora.

error_comun.nota: Más abstracta; el cierre es frase de póster y la noticia llega tarde.

contradiccion+g1.nota: Gancho concreto y con 'your'; cierre retoma 'share'.

contradiccion+g2.nota: Adelanta la cifra y quema el giro de Forbes.

contradiccion+g3.nota: 'owns none' bonito pero choca con 'sold every share' después.

contradiccion+g4.nota: 'before the boom' resume el final antes de tiempo.
